leads.skip_prompt: Skip every Inbox lead scoring below:
leads.skip_confirm: Skip {count} leads scoring below {n}? You can find them under Skipped.
leads.empty_text: Search for people who are hiring, or local businesses that need help.
leads.empty_stage_text: Change the filters or pick another stage above.
leads.pick_text: Select one on the left. Keys: j / k to move, s shortlist, x skip, c contacted, g write message.
msg.ph: Click "Write message" to draft a first message from this lead's details. You review it and send it yourself.
msg.ai_setup: Set up an AI provider in Settings first
msg.ai_failed: AI failed, used the template instead: {err}
audit.blocked: This site blocked the automated check (bot protection). Open it in your browser and look yourself before pitching.
audit.ok: No issues found. This site looks fine; pitch something else or move on.
find.hiring_desc: Finds posts where someone asks for a freelancer, ranked by how well they match your skills.
src_desc.freelancer: New client projects in your categories, worldwide
src_desc.reddit: Hiring posts in r/forhire and the communities from Settings
src_desc.hn: "Seeking freelancer" and contract posts from the monthly threads
src_desc.github: Open issues with bounty and help-wanted labels
src_desc.mastodon: Fediverse posts asking for help, any language (fewer, noisier)
src_desc.rss: Job board feeds you added in Settings
find.search_hint: Takes about a minute. Some sites are slow on purpose to stay polite.
find.local_desc: Finds businesses near any place in the world and checks their websites for problems you can fix.
find.kind_q: What kind of business? (click to choose)
find.other_ph: Other: an OpenStreetMap tag like shop=bicycle
find.check_sites_hint: Slower, but this is what gives you something concrete to say.
find.local_tip: Tip: "Only without a website" is the quickest way to find clients who need a site.
find.check_desc: Paste any business website to see what is wrong with it and get a ready-made pitch.
find.booking: This business takes bookings (restaurant, clinic, salon…)
find.pick_kind: Choose at least one kind of business
err.429: The site asked us to slow down. Try again in a few minutes.
err.notfound: That place was not found. Try adding the country.
set.draft_language_hint: Automatic writes to each business in its own language
set.about_desc: Used to rank leads and write your messages.
set.profession_hint: Fills in skills, pitch, sources and business types for this kind of work. You can edit everything after.
set.name: Your name
set.signature_hint: How you sign messages, e.g. Name | website
set.pitch: What you do, in one sentence
set.skills_hint: Comma separated. Leads that mention these rank higher.
set.avoid_hint: Leads with these are pushed down hard.
set.freelancer_hint: Live client projects worldwide, the richest source for most work
set.freelancer_cats_hint: Comma separated, e.g. Website-Design, Translation, Logo-Design
set.mastodon_hint: Worldwide and multilingual, but few and noisy results
set.gh_token_hint: set the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable for higher limits
set.ai_desc: Without this, messages come from translated templates. With it, an AI writes a draft from the lead's details. You still review and send it.
set.keys_hint: keys are read from environment variables and never saved to disk
wiz.welcome_text: Tell it what you do, and it will find people and businesses that need exactly that.
wiz.what: What kind of work do you do?
wiz.pick_one: Pick the work closest to yours
wiz.name: Your name
wiz.first_text: leadhound will look for people hiring right now. You can also search local businesses near you.
wiz.city_hint: Leave empty to only search for hiring posts
login.title: Sign in
quit.title: leadhound has stopped
quit.text: You can close this tab. Open leadhound again from the desktop icon.
today.empty_text: Click the big button. leadhound looks for people who need your work right now.
today.city_q: Want local businesses too? Add your city:
today.done_text: No new matches right now. Click "Find new clients" again later.
today.msg_hint: Read it, change anything you like, then send it yourself.
today.no_contact: No contact details found. Use "Open the page" to reach them there.
quit.confirm_text: It stops running on this computer. Your leads and accounts stay saved.
set.daily_goal_hint: Messages you aim to send each day. Shown as the ring on Today.
today.sub: Three easy steps. You send every message yourself.
today.pick_first: Pick a match first, then write to it.
today.hero_title: Find people who need your work
today.hero_text: leadhound searches Freelancer.com, Reddit and more, and ranks the best matches for you.
today.found_text: The best one scores {score}. Take a look and write to the ones you like.
today.found_text0: Everything we found is already in your list.
today.goal_text: Send {n} messages today. A few every day beats a lot once.
today.best_none: No matches yet. Press the big button above.
today.sources_text: Free sources. No logins, nothing to set up.
today.cb_title: Send from where you already are
today.cb_none: No accounts connected yet. Messages open with your text ready.
compose.tip1: Mention one detail from their post.
compose.opened: Opened {name}. Press send there, then come back and tap “I sent it”.
compose.copied_open: Message copied. Paste it in {name} and send.
note.off: {name} is turned off. Turn it on to use it.
note.none: No contact found for this lead. Copy the message and send it yourself.
note.whatsapp: Opens WhatsApp with your message ready. You press send there.
note.telegram: Copies your message, then opens the chat. Paste it and press send there.
note.copy_page: Copies your message, then opens the page. Paste it there and send.
note.mailto: Opens your mail app with the message ready. You press send there.
note.tail: leadhound never sends on its own.
acct.title: Where you send from
acct.text: Most platforms already work: leadhound opens them with your message filled in. Connect an account only if you want leadhound to send for you.
acct.trust2: Nothing sends until you press Send
acct.sec_send: Optional: let leadhound send for you
acct.sec_link: Ready to use. Nothing to set up
acct.d.email: Gmail, Outlook or any mail account. Best for local businesses.
acct.d.mastodon: Direct messages to people who post a request.
acct.d.github: Comment on paid issues and bounties.
acct.d.reddit: Private messages to people who post a request.
acct.d.freelancer: Opens the project page. Your message is copied for you to paste into your bid.
acct.d.whatsapp: Opens a chat with the lead's phone number and your message ready.
acct.d.telegram: Opens the chat with the lead. Your message is copied for you to paste.
acct.warn_reddit: Reddit limits new accounts and cold messages. leadhound caps Reddit at {cap} a day to protect your account.
acct.where: Logins are saved in {path}. Only your user can read the file, but it is not encrypted.
sheet.title: Connect {name}
sheet.email_sub: Use an app password, not your normal password.
sheet.email_ok: A test email is on its way to you.
sheet.email_help: How do I get an app password?
sheet.email_help_1: Turn on 2-step verification for your mail account.
sheet.email_help_2: Open the security page and choose App passwords.
sheet.email_help_3: Create one called leadhound and paste it above.
sheet.mast_sub: Create an access token on your server and paste it here.
sheet.mast_help_1: On your server, open Preferences, then Development.
sheet.mast_help_2: Create a new application and tick write:statuses.
sheet.mast_help_3: Copy “Your access token” and paste it above.
sheet.gh_sub: Use a personal access token that can write issues.
sheet.gh_help_1: Open GitHub Settings, then Developer settings.
sheet.gh_help_2: Create a fine-grained token with Issues: Read and write.
sheet.gh_help_3: Copy the token and paste it above.
sheet.how_token: How do I get a token?
sheet.rd_sub: Create a script app on Reddit and paste its details.
sheet.rd_help_1: Open reddit.com/prefs/apps and create an app of type script.
sheet.rd_help_2: Copy the id under the app name, and the secret.
sheet.rd_help_3: Paste them here with your username and password.
sheet.how_app: How do I create the app?
acct.d.gmail: Opens a new Gmail message with everything filled in. Uses the account you are already signed in to.
acct.d.outlook: Opens a new Outlook message with everything filled in. Uses the account you are already signed in to.
note.gmail: Opens Gmail with the message filled in. You press send there.
note.outlook: Opens Outlook with the message filled in. You press send there.

plan.f4: Local business finder and website checks
